description.zh: 绑定的描述信息。长度为1~128个字符，默认值为空。
description.en: The description of the binding. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length. By default, no description is applied.

description.zh: 和当前项目处于同一地域(Region)的OSS Bucket名称。
description.en: The name of the OSS bucket in the same region as the project.

description.zh: 项目名称，创建方式请参见[创建项目](~~478153~~)。
description.en: The name of the project. For information about how to create a project, see [CreateProject](~~478153~~).

descriptions.zh:
- **请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解智能媒体管理产品的收费方式和[价格](~~477042~~)。**
- 该接口是通过OSS x-oss-process方式使用IMM数据处理能力的前置条件，详见[x-oss-process使用指南](~~2391270~~)。
- 调用该接口前，请确保当前Region已经存在可用的项目（Project），详见[项目管理](~~478152~~)。
descriptions.en:
*   Before you call this operation, make sure that you are familiar with the [billing](~~477042~~) of Intelligent Media Management (IMM).****
*   To use data processing capabilities of IMM based on the x-oss-process parameter, you must bind an OSS bucket to an IMM project. For more information, see [x-oss-process](~~2391270~~).
*   Make sure that the specified project exists in the current region. For more information, see [Project management](~~478152~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun imm attach-oss-bucket --project-name immtest --oss-bucket examplebucket --description test-attachment --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun imm AttachOSSBucket --region cn-hangzhou --Description 'test-attachment' --ProjectName immtest --OSSBucket examplebucket
